name: unsafe fn get_unchecked_mut < I > (& mut self , index : I) -> & mut I :: Output where I : SliceIndex < Self > ,
rule: For safety, `index` must be in bounds for `self` when calling `get_unchecked_mut`, even if the resulting reference is never used or is immediately converted to a pointer. In particular, an element index equal to `self.len()`, a range `..self.len() + 1`, or an inclusive range `..=self.len()` is out of bounds and causes undefined behavior.
api: impl < T > [T] { unsafe fn get_unchecked_mut < I > (& mut self , index : I) -> & mut I::Output where I : SliceIndex < Self > , }
